name: Production Cutover Checklist / 正式上線切換檢查表

AI provider keys must only exist in main-site server runtime, never browser bundles
Beinan/Peinan archaeological site terms must remain forbidden for Pinuyumayan culture source packets
synthetic public TTS remains disabled until model + human language review passes

MySQL/MariaDB listens only localhost/private LAN/VPN, not public internet
pinuyumayan backend systemd service enabled

ALLOWED_ORIGINS contains only production main-site origins plus explicit staging origins
PINUYUMAYAN_HMAC_ENABLED=true
